# Smart Pharma System

> Enterprise Inventory, Task, Production, and Salary Management System for Pharmaceutical Operations.

## Overview
Smart Pharma System provides automated workflows for inventory tracking, production dispatch, attendance management, and salary advances across multi-company operations.

## Features
- **Dashboard**: Real-time KPI summaries for tasks, inventory, and attendance.
- **Inventory Management**: Track foil stock, plastic stock, and cylinder inventory.
- **Task Dispatch**: Generate QR codes, dispatch shipments, and track worker task progress.
- **Attendance & HR**: Shift logging, leave approvals, and monthly salary advance management.
